skill_name: Given a situation, discuss the impacts of technology on the situation.
workflow: Technology has helped to ensure that education continues even in the midst of a pandemic, allowing students to access virtual classrooms with ease. It has enabled the continuity of learning by providing online tools, platforms, and educational resources to students. Technology has also enabled educational institutions to provide different learning models, like flipped classrooms and microlearning, and it can also facilitate collaboration among students and teachers.
